rules: No Inter or generic fonts for headings.
Tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Line height tight for headers (leading-tight), relaxed for body (leading-relaxed).

grids_and_layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) for ecommerce sections. Always map direct children to grid containers.
grids_and_layouts.product_catalog: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. High emphasis on product flags/imagery, prominent prices, and clear 'Add to Cart' CTAs.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: High density grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for summary widgets. Side navigation for layout wrapper.
grids_and_layouts.auth_layout: Split screen layout. Image on one side, clean centered form on the other.

components.navbar: Sticky to top (sticky top-0 z-50), backdrop-blur-xl (bg-white/80 or bg-slate-900/80). Must include Dark/Light toggle and Cart icon with badge.
components.cards: Modern Card Design: Soft shadow (shadow-md, shadow-lg on hover), rounded-2xl, crisp 1px border. Inside padding p-6.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or rounded-xl for main CTAs. Smooth transition on hover (-translate-y-1).
components.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-lg, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500. Error states must be clear with red borders.
components.empty_states: Minimalist layout with a soft muted icon and text. Always include a prominent CTA to redirect users (e.g., 'Go to Shop').
components.notifications: Use 'sonner' for Success & Error notifications. Top-right positioning.
components.footer: Professional footer with multiple columns. Large brand presence (QO), helpful links, and copyright text.

motion.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) for product cards and primary buttons.
motion.loading: Smooth skeleton loaders for product fetching and dashboard data (animate-pulse).

hero_image.description: Person using a smartphone - for landing page hero or auth screen background

product_japan.description: Japan flag with autumn trees - for Japan Virtual Number product card

product_canada.description: Canadian flag waving - for Canada Virtual Number product card

product_indonesia.description: Indonesian flag on pole - for Indonesia Virtual Number product card

payment_qris.description: QR Code close-up - placeholder for QRIS manual payment display

specific_features.auth_captcha: Implement a basic visual or math CAPTCHA in the login/register form for security.
specific_features.invoice_print: Use a dedicated print stylesheet (@media print) or window.print() logic to hide navbar, footer, and sidebars. The receipt should be clean, tabular, and professional.
specific_features.whatsapp_proof: The 'Send Proof' button must open a wa.me link with a pre-filled message containing the Order ID and Customer Name.
specific_features.admin_table: Dense data tables for orders. Use colored status badges: Pending (Yellow), Approved (Green), Rejected (Red).

instructions_to_main_agent: Write components using .js/.jsx extensions since the environment is standard React JS, NOT TypeScript.
Implement the UI directly using Tailwind CSS and raw HTML where Shadcn components feel too restrictive (e.g., hero sections).
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions: Dialogs, Selects, Dropdowns, and Tables.
Use the specific image URLs provided in 'media_and_images'. DO NOT use placeholder text.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for navbars, dropdowns, or modals. Always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl + semi-transparent background).
DO NOT apply generic centered alignments (`text-center`) everywhere. Left-align dense text, tables, and form inputs to respect human reading patterns.
ALL interactive elements and key text MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='cart-total').
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally. Target specific properties (e.g., 'transition-colors transition-transform').
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (e.g., hover state color change, slight scale transform).
Ensure standard WCAG/APCA contrast ratios between text and background colors.
